newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria names new council areas for elections.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria names new council areas for elections.

text.p: Nigeria's military government on Thursday announced the names of 183 new local government areas where multiparty elections are scheduled for this month.
A statement from secretary to the government Alhaji Gidado Idris said precise details of the boundaries would be announced at a later date.
The first multiparty elections in Nigeria since the army annulled a 1993 ballot are due to take place in the last quarter of the year in all 772 local government areas.

But so far no date has been set, and the delay in naming the local government areas and registering voters has led to speculation that the government might fall behind on its schedule to restore democracy by October 1998.
The timetable to restore civilian rule set out last year by General Sani Abacha has been criticised by both Western countries and local opposition activists for taking too long.
Africa's most populous nation was plunged into political crisis in 1993, when a former military government annulled presidential elections that would have ended a decade of army rule.
